remarks: Absolutely love where you live! Extraordinary transformation w/unbeatable curb appeal in prime, central location on the edge of West Norwalk where all neighborhoods converge! 3BR, 2FBA storybook Colonial w/approx 700sf full-flr expansion & complete down-to-the-studs renovation comprises high quality, thoughtfully integrated finishes w/all new roof, siding, plumbing, electrical & 2-zone gas heat & C/A. City water/sewer, too! Light-filled living rm w/view to sparkling kitchen features new SS appliances (gas ckg), soft-close wood cabinets & beautiful quartz! MAIN LVL BR w/dbl-closets & easy access to FBA w/XL walk-in shower (recessed shelf & window). Upstairs: open & airy sitting area (perfect as office/workout/guest area), spacious BRs, each w/a dbl-closet & stunning FBA w/great natural light. Tastefully chosen style & colors thru-out, from flrs & doors to hardware & light fixtures. New switches & outlets, too! Spanning entire footprint of home, LL given equal care & attention & w/floored attic & sizeable shed, storage abounds! Deck also impressive in both size & condition! W/in 1mi to almost everything you would need or want! From SoNo RR to I95; to simple commute to schools & hospital; to restaurants, entertainment & retail (Washington Prime, Barcelona, Maritime Aquarium, theaters, Apple, Nordstrom to name a few); to all that is just around the corner (Starbucks, Trader Joes, Stop & Shop, parks, beach, golf, tennis etc), settle right in to warmth, comfort & convenience today!
